why: The frame names are record data, not literals: resources/examples/data/ai_contacts.json names 590 of these 989 files as `ai_images/<id>.jpg`, and an example reads the record to pick one. Which of the remaining 399 a record set ends up using is not derivable from the tree, so the folder is matched as a prefix.

The folder is a constant and each file name is a member's data in the same file: apps/portal/view/about/Container.mjs carries `picture: 'Max.jpeg'` beside the folder it is joined with. The two segments never appear together in a text file.
src/component/Circle.mjs holds the folder base and the three names in an array (`itemFile = ['flip.png', 'pencil.png', 'trash.png']`) and joins them at runtime, as its `itemCls` counterpart shows.
Referenced from the sibling main container as `src: './RangeHeader.jpg'` — relative to its own folder, so the reference carries no parent directory for the folder-and-name match to compare.
